refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: metrics-exporter.conf configures metrics-exporter8, the service which exports additional system metrics for systemd-report1.

refsect1.title: Configuration Directories and Precedence
refsect1.para: The configuration is read following the UAPI Configuration Files Specification. The main configuration file metrics-exporter.conf is looked up in the metrics-exporter namespace below the following directories, listed here from lowest to highest precedence:

listitem.para: Vendor defaults shipped by the distribution package. Files here should not be edited by the administrator, as they may be overwritten on package updates.
Local administrator configuration. Settings here take precedence over the vendor defaults and are the recommended place for local changes.

refsect1.para: In addition to the main configuration file, drop-in files with a .conf suffix are read from a metrics-exporter.conf.d/ directory located next to the main file in each of the directories above (for example /etc/metrics-exporter/metrics-exporter.conf.d/ and /usr/share/metrics-exporter/metrics-exporter.conf.d/).
All files are merged into a single configuration.

refsect1.title: File Format
refsect1.para: The file uses a simple INI-style syntax. It is organized into sections (groups) and key=value assignments. Everything following a # character is treated as a comment and ignored. Leading and trailing whitespace around values are stripped.

listitem.para: General options controlling the behaviour of metrics-exporter8 itself.
Options controlling which groups of metrics are exported.
Options specific to the SELinux metrics.
A boolean value which enables debug mode. Enabling debug mode also enables verbose logging. The built-in default is false. This is equivalent to the --debug command line option.
A boolean value which enables verbose logging. The built-in default is true. This is equivalent to the --verbose command line option.
A boolean value which controls whether the SELinux metrics are exported at all. The built-in default is true.

A boolean value which controls whether the state of the SELinux policy booleans is included in the org.openSUSE.Metrics.SELinux.PolicyBooleans metric. The built-in default is true. This option has no effect if selinux is disabled in the [Metrics] section.

example.title: /etc/metrics-exporter/metrics-exporter.conf
example.programlisting:
[Global] #debug=false verbose=true
[Metrics] # SELinux metrics are enabled per default selinux=true
[SELinux] # Do not report the individual SELinux policy booleans booleans=false
